{{Top|leg}}
A '''Motility Track''' was an exercise running track. Runners could vary the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] of the lanes. The [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] [[Kuari Princess/Legends|''Kuari Princess'']] had a Motility Track running around the exterior of the [[Recreation Deck]].
